project_name.justification: The text refers to the project as the 'Roger Gold-Copper Project ("Roger" or the "Project")'.

company_name.justification: The second article identifies the buyer: 'XXIX Metal Corp. (TSXV: XXIX) ("XXIX" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has closed its arm's length acquisition of the remaining 50% ownership interest in the Roger Gold-Copper Project'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The contact information for the buyer in both articles lists 'Stephen Stewart, Chief Executive Officer'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The company is acquiring the interest it does not already own: 'QC Copper to acquire the remaining 50% ownership interest from SOQUEM'.

primary_commodity.justification: The project is referred to as the 'Roger Gold-Copper Project' and the resource is measured in 'gold equivalent', with the headline stating 'Acquires 100% Ownership of Roger Gold Project'.

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled 'XXIX Closes Acquisition of 100% Ownership of Roger Gold Project in Chibougamau, Quebec', which directly relates to the project of interest.

currency.justification: The transaction payments are denoted with a '$' symbol. The acquiring company, XXIX Metal Corp., is listed on the Canadian TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV), implying the currency is Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The terms of the agreement include an initial cash payment: 'Pursuant to the Agreement, XXIX has paid initial compensation to SOQUEM of $75,000.'

share_payments_raw.justification: The agreement outlines four future share payments totaling $1,600,000: '$450,000 in common shares...$425,000 in Common Shares...$375,000 in Common Shares...and $350,000 in Common Shares'.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Cash and share payments are listed separately, so this combined field is not applicable.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The exact number of shares is not fixed and depends on future stock prices: 'The number of Common Shares to be issued to SOQUEM will be calculated on the basis of the higher of: (i) an issue price per Common Share equal to the volume-weighted average price for the 10 days preceding the issue date... or; (ii) $0.05 per Common Share.'

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any payments in the form of share warrants.

option_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any payments in the form of options.

issued_share_price.justification: The share price for the transaction is not a fixed value but is calculated based on a future volume-weighted average price or a floor price of $0.05.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text does not mention any exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters for the Roger project.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The text mentions a '$1,500,000 in work obligations' but this is explicitly for the 'Cooke-Robitaille property', not the Roger project. No exploration commitment value is mentioned for the Roger project.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: As part of the transaction, a royalty was granted to the seller: 'In connection with the Agreement, the Company has also granted SOQUEM a 2.0% net smelter royalty in respect of the Project (the "NSR").'

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text specifies the size of the project area: 'The Roger Project spans 987-hectares'.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text specifies the unit for the project area: 'The Roger Project spans 987-hectares'.

resource_size.justification: A summary of the project's resource is provided in the highlights: 'Roger has a 43-101 resource estimate showing 535,000 ounces gold equivalent @ 0.95 g/t AuEq.'

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the first line of the second news release: 'XXIX Metal Corp. (TSXV: XXIX)'.
